name: Trim Initial Prep (Wood)
intent: Dust wipe trim, fill fastener holes, fill end grain (MDF and FJP only), caulk joints between trim pieces, light sand smooth. Sets the trim up for primer adhesion. Some tasks gate by substrate condition because they only apply to certain wood types.
doctrine: End grain fill only fires for MDF and FJP — solid wood and factory-primed don't need it because solid wood has no exposed grain ends and factory-primed already has end grain sealed. Caulking joints applies to all conditions because joints exist in any trim install. Sand prep is light sand to break primer adhesion sites; not the same as full sanding (which is part of inspect/repair on subsequent passes).
